title: SchedulingRuleParameter - Data API
description: Represents scheduling rule parameters associated with a scheduling rule. This object is available in API version 52.0 and later.

SchedulingParameterKey.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
SchedulingParameterKey.description: The scheduling rule parameter name. Possible values are: ConsiderAbsence—Consider absences when determining a service resource’s availability. This type is available in API version 56.0 and later. ConsiderSTM—Consider service territory membership when determining a service resource’s availability. Service territory membership defines the resource’s working hours in a location. This type is available in API version 56.0 and later. C—Constraint Field Name L—Limit Type R—Resolution T—Time Resolution W—Work Unit

SchedulingRuleId.description: The scheduling rule ID. This is a relationship field.

Value.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
